name: Chibi Majo
source:
Level: 33

The most powerful of the heroines. She has a wealth of magical knowledge and is skilled in offensive magic. She used to travel with another heroic party, but she ran away from them and is now living on a deserted island. She is a sexually active and naïve bitch.

[Translated from [url=http://www.caramel-box.com/products/geko-brave/character.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
